To answer your question, I will refer to the text on page 11 of the provided document.

The NFA variant that retained the most capacity after 100 cycles at C/3 is the NFA-A variant. 

The aluminium and iron contents of the NFA-A variant are 15% and 5%, respectively.

To find the c lattice parameter for the NFA-A variant, I will refer to Table 1 on page 5 of the provided document.

The c lattice parameter for the Al-rich NFA variant is 14.2232(4) Å.
